coordinate_convention: raw UV bottom-left origin; image x=u*W, y=(1-v)*H; image sample centers are x+0.5,y+0.5
source: native game LOD0 geometry; no texture colors or custom-skin edge detection
overlaps: All physical islands retained, including stacked UVs; no covering islands suppressed.
repeat_uv_handling: Raw coordinates retained. repeat_uv.npz clips every integer tile into 0..1 with source-triangle/tile links; mapper applies this by default.
